## Football effect

Murphy missed the August 15 review and the August 16 practice (one practice and the August 17 day off) and was released August 18, his projected date; he took part normally August 18 to 21 and, by the condition in Stone's Detroit plan (cleared early enough to practice normally), reentered the developmental rotation for the August 22 game. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the hold; his game-2 work (three carries for 18) stands as recorded. Four elapsed days, one missed practice, no missed game. A release does not automatically restore the previous role.
